content:
**骨**家具套装适用于[**Fantasy's Furniture**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fantasy-furniture)，添加了功能齐全的家具，包括但不限于：**箱子**、**抽屉**、**床**、**座椅**等！ 该家具套装包含两种变体：**骷髅**与**凋灵**，两者提供相同的家具方块列表。 ### 合成配方
若要制作**骨砖**，你需要放入 **#minecraft:stone_crafting_materials**。 ![stonecutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_bone/stonecutter_bricks.png) 若要制作**骨**家具方块，你需要将 **#fantasyfurniture:binding_agent**、**骨砖**与**灵魂沙**一同放入**家具工作站**中。 ![skeleton-furniture-station](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_bone/skeleton_furniture_station.png) ![wither-furniture-station](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_bone/wither_furniture_station.png)
